name: @ethonline2026/arc-client
description: Low-level Arc L1 wrapper for the Agentic EMS: CCTP V2 burn-and-mint, Arc App Kit (Send/Bridge/Swap/Unified Balance), StableFX, Agent Wallet, and ERC-8183 Agentic Commerce kernel bindings. All chain I/O for Arc lives here — LangChain tools consume this package and never touch SDKs directly.
